name: Lavinia Browning
source:
Lav is lively and communicative. While easygoing and open-minded, she seems uncompromising to unnecessary extremes. These extremes evolve over time, suddenly exposing a more severe ego. 

[spoiler]
Original Lavinia Browning was a big shot music producer hence why she got a place in a CELL unit. She also was in charge of Marble Media, company managed and financed by one of Teutonae's foundations. Her family was influential on its own beside that too.
